title: A practical benefit of polymorphism
answer: Polymorphism is useful when one workflow should process several implementations through a common contract. In AeroTopo, code can work with `Product` values without branching on whether each object is an Orthomosaic or DEM; calling `resolutionMetres()` or `export()` automatically uses subtype behavior. This makes new product types easier to add because callers can remain written against the stable Product or Exportable contract instead of accumulating type checks.
